description: T51: one prompt per AssetKeys constant, authored from docs/asset-specification.md (T49). Sprite prompts bake in the neutral-silhouette style the generator keys out to alpha: a light/white subject on a solid flat pure magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background, which the generator keys out by hue (a hue test cannot hit a light or grey subject). The sixteen-nation palette (asset-specification.md 2.3) is applied at DRAW time by tinting, not baked into the sprites, because the keys are one per tier, not one per nation. Terrain tile prompts are full-frame opaque tiles; the four T148 shore-overlay prompts use the same magenta chroma key as a marker, which the generator keys out to a 32-bit transparent overlay drawn over a land cell. sfx prompts describe short sound cues, synthesized locally (no image API produces audio). Every prompt describes a generic ancient-Mediterranean subject and never references the original game, its art, its name or its screenshots (T51 DoD 7).

prompts.prompt: An ancient Mediterranean light infantry soldier standing in side profile: a lightly clad foot soldier in a short tunic with no body armour, a small round shield held forward on the leading arm and two throwing javelins in the other hand. Pixel-art game sprite: a single subject centred in the frame with clear empty margins, drawn as a bold, simple silhouette in light grey to near-white, with strong simple shapes that stay readable when the whole image is scaled down to 32x32 pixels. The background is a solid, flat, pure magenta (#FF00FF) filling the entire frame, with no shadow, no gradient, no ground line, no scenery and no shading, and with no magenta on the subject itself; no border, no frame, no text.
prompts.source: docs/asset-specification.md 4.1 unit icons table: 'Light infantry - a lightly-armoured foot soldier, minimal shield'
